description: The floating literal continuation indicator (ISO 6.2.3.1: a quotation symbol followed by a hyphen, ending a line inside an unterminated alphanumeric, boolean or national literal) - in either reference format; the continuation line begins with the opening quotation symbol and its content is appended to the latest logical line (6.5 4) and 8)). It is the only way to continue a literal in free form and the only way to continue a national literal in either format (6.3.5 2)), and the replacement the 2023 text recommends for the obsolete column-7 hyphen (Annex F.2 item 4). Recognized in ONE place, the 6.5 logical conversion's LogicalLineBuilder (kb/Work PB1359), which also enforces 6.2.3.2 SR4-SR6 (COBOL2684-2687, 2689, 2690). THE EDGE IS DERIVED, NOT QUOTED (rows 7.21/7.23's discipline; the repo holds no 2002 or 2014 text): the floating indicators are one table in 6.2.3.1 and the M2 post-85 feature catalog places the floating indicators in COBOL-2002; Annex E, which itemizes the 2014->2023 delta, does not list them, so they predate 2023. Gated in FIXED form only, once per compilation - the reference format a COBOL-85 source is written in; free form is itself a 2002 introduction reached below 2002 only through the documented auto-detection extension (DOC-A.1-158), where this indicator is its only continuation.
citation: ISO §2023:6.2.3.1 (floating indicators, both reference formats); §2023:6.5 GR4 and §2023:6.5 GR8; a COBOL-2002 introduction (M2 catalog derivation, VCR row 7.21 discipline)
